# The negative-control corpus (design report, section 7, property 2):
# real apps that ship no code of another company than their publisher. A
# scan of them must find no channel to any other company, at any grade
# and any confidence. They are never stored in this repository: each line
# pins one by the SHA-256 of its file, the name it has in the cache, where
# its publisher offers it, the set it is in, and for a zip the app inside.
#
#   cargo xtask fixtures negatives --dir DIR [--all]
#   EXPOSURE_NEGATIVE_CACHE=DIR [EXPOSURE_NEGATIVE_SET=all] cargo test -p exposure --test negative_corpus
#
# Set `every-change` is scanned by CI on every change; `nightly` only in the
# nightly run, which scans every app. A zip is unpacked into <file>.d.
#
# sha256  file  url  set  app
